stories.headline: McIlroy equals a golf record with an eighth Race to Dubai
stories.summary: Rory McIlroy has won the Race to Dubai for the eighth time, equalling Colin Montgomerie's record for the most Harry Vardon Trophies. He claimed the season-long title after finishing second at the DP World Tour Championship.

stories.headline: Australia win a fourth straight women's rugby league World Cup
stories.summary: Australia have won the Women's Rugby League World Cup for the fourth time in a row. They defeated New Zealand 34–10 in the final in Brisbane.

stories.headline: Cape Verde returns José Maria Neves for a second term
stories.summary: Presidential elections were held in Cape Verde on 15 November 2026. The incumbent, José Maria Neves, was re-elected to a second consecutive term in the first round, against Joana Rosa. Cape Verde is an archipelagic country in the eastern Atlantic Ocean, off the coast of West Africa.

stories.headline: A dead star pulses every eight minutes beside a Sun-like companion
stories.summary: Astronomers have found a dead star sending out radio pulses every eight minutes while orbiting a Sun-like star more than 5,000 light-years away. It is the first time such signals have been identified in a system where a white dwarf orbits a Sun-like star. The discovery was made by researchers at the Curtin University branch of the International Centre for Radio Astronomy Research.
